operation.authentication: original ordinary Core bearer and current company administrator

structural_enable.meaning: configured current profile; does not establish live OAuth or external CREATE eligibility
structural_enable.user_kind: at least one existing configured User and current same-company Member with nonempty legal selection
structural_enable.machine_kind: at least one configured exact company/client/installation/kind=machine/userNULL grant and client_secret_basic client
nonempty: profile organizations intersect own_organization_id for user
profile counterparties intersect canonical resource scope
profile locations intersect objects scope and installation locations and Member.object_scope for user
at least one profile type active in current catalog
structural_enable.false_false: legal selection may be empty; current auth, structural integrity and CAS remain required

freeze_before_b: full canonical Member rows including organization_id and own_organization_id
full row JSON scopes and current type activity
physical_stage: complete Counterparty/Organization/ServiceLocation union in fixed model/id order
transaction.checkpoint: after every wait, after actual flush, before coherent readback; original public native auth/admin plus closed gate
transaction.same_flags: valid CAS still increments generation and adds audit
transaction.completion: HTTP owner commits; internal sync service leaves root completion to actual caller
transaction.lost_commit_ack: UNKNOWN; fresh current-auth GET readback; no blind retry or assertion of rollback success
transaction.disable_or_rollback: new CAS at current generation; never restore an old generation

errors.401_403: original native identity or company administrator denial
errors.409: stale generation, overflow, drift, revoked enable, structural or nonempty legal selection denial
errors.422: strict request denial or unchanged discovery helper invalid ref/grant binding denial
errors.503: closed admin gate or original OAuth/Core gate disabled

preserved.profile_composition: unchanged ProfileOperation(installation_id,None); explicit private composition of discovery/snapshot/recheck/readback

contexts: real Authlib-issued bearer before and after actual App/grant revocation
real get_db AsyncSession and caller completion
original B and exact actual root/Connection/capability
actual PostgreSQL PIDs, pg_locks and pg_blocking_pids
physical parent union and zero-Member boundary
fresh independent full child SQL rows and business counts
negative after-wait and after-flush SQL authority changes
atomic audit, cancel, root rollback and unknown ACK

evidence_limits.author_tools: FS/Git and independently authored stdlib AST/JSON/hash/in-memory compile without exec
evidence_limits.source_review: fresh independent FULL review owned by coordinator; not claimed here
